get.description: Get custom domains of the specified application, the application type should be protected app.

200.description: An array of the application custom domains.

400.description: Faild to sync the domain info from remote provider.

post.summary: Add a custom domain to the application.
post.description: Add a custom domain to the application. You'll need to setup DNS record later.

domain.description: The domain to be added to the application. It must not contain whitespace. The value is canonicalized before it is stored: lowercased, with any trailing dots removed. Hostnames under the reserved Protected App default domain are rejected.

201.description: The domain has been added to the application.

422.description: Exceeded the maximum number of domains allowed, the domain is invalid, or the domain is under the reserved Protected App default domain.

delete.description: Remove custom domain from the specified application.
